body:
Finished the SHANKPIT-side half of S459-41. IDUNA already shipped the
is_default_queue admin flag (migration, store, PATCH endpoint, NOCK editor
button) and NEWPIT (id=8) was set live as default via direct DB write (no
admin cookie session available for the HTTP path).

This change wires SHANKPIT's own server (queue_activate_match) and client
(client_load_queue_level) to search entries[i].is_default_queue in the level
registry instead of a hardcoded name match on "44". Live-verified via a
NET_VERBOSE_LOG diagnostic build against an isolated test port + a real
emily-bot connection: server logs QUEUE_LEVEL_LOADED name=NEWPIT id=8 boxes=16.

Also fixed a real, found-live Makefile bug along the way: ea-windows targeted
i686-w64-mingw32-gcc but the only mingw SDL2 dev kit on this box is x86_64 --
the target never actually linked here. Fixed to x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc with
the real SDL2 .la dependency-lib set; dist/ea-windows/shank_lobby.exe now
builds and was hand-delivered to the founder.

Live server (shankpit-server.service) redeployed; bot pool auto-reconnected
via its existing stale-connection retry (added earlier this session).

Commit: SHANKPIT@0209a51

⚓ ☃
title: S459-41: QUEUE default level now admin-flag-driven (is_default_queue), NEWPIT live
